office_does: The sheriff runs the Clark County Sheriff's Office, which patrols unincorporated Clark County, investigates crimes, serves civil process and warrants, and operates the county jail.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Sheriff John Horch, elected in 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Incumbent Clark County Sheriff seeking a second term; previously the office's enforcement chief and drug task force commander. The only candidate.
highlights: Sheriff for the past four years; formerly enforcement chief, drug task force commander and FBI organized-crime task force member [S1]
Cites added patrol and investigations staffing, a body-worn camera program and a regional police academy [S1]
Says increasing deputy staffing remains his top priority; the office is among the lowest-funded in the state by officer-to-citizen ratio [S1]
